notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, adventurers! We're excited to share another development update. Today, we’ll cover key systems making the game more convenient, deeper, and engaging. Let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][h3]Player Profiles and Saving[/h3][p]Imagine: you want to start fresh or let a friend play on your PC. Now it’s easy! We’ve implemented a convenient local player profile system.[/p][list][*][p]One Profile – Your Whole Story. Campaign progress is tied to your profile, not individual characters. Create a mage, warrior, or seeker — they’ll all share your story progress and a common inventory. If a quest is too tough for one character, switch to another![/p][/*][*][p]Multiple Players? No Problem! Different people can play on one PC — each with their own profile and progress. Starting from scratch? Just create a new profile![/p][/*][*][p]Your Settings – Always Ready. Key bindings and personal preferences are saved per profile for maximum comfort.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/e1e3cdbcfe9ca490e3de9010f9b44ecfe30fa0e8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Status Effect System and Encyclopedia[/h3][p]The world just got more dangerous and intriguing! We’ve built a robust status effect system that works both for and against you.[/p][list][*][p]Stronger Enemies. Karamarin’s beasts no longer just attack. They can regenerate, resurrect, dodge projectiles, and more! Status effects are core to their evolving mechanics — and their arsenal will keep growing![/p][/*][*][p]Stronger Magic. The spellcrafting system gains new components:[/p][list][*][p]Offensive Debuff: Make enemies weaker! Effect type depends on activation method and element. Example: Projectile + Lightning = Stun.[/p][/*][*][p]Elemental Switch: Cycle through elements! A single spell can now alternate between fire and water.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Encyclopedia at Hand. With effects and mechanics constantly expanding, we’ve added an in-game reference guide. Find everything instantly: enemy traits, effect descriptions, spell components — your complete compendium of magic and lore![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/f10ae693bd92a56b5c01a0c62d5ab5f28d4c3159.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Mana: The Cost of Power[/h3][p]Magic gains depth: we’re finally adding the long-requested mana and spell power system. Power now has a tangible cost![/p][list][*][p]Each spell has Power Score, calculated from its complexity (every component contributes). Your character has Magic Power.[/p][list][*][p]Free Casting: If a spell’s Power is lower than your Magic Power — cast with no mana cost![/p][/*][*][p]Power Tax: If Power is higher — prepare to spend mana.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increase your Magic Power to reduce mana costs for powerful spells or cast them for free.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced Costs: What if a component triggers ten times per cast? Or never activates? We’ve solved it! Secondary action components (e.g., "On Hit") have lower Power Score, but spend extra mana per trigger. No overpaying for "misses" or exploiting "multi-hits". Well, ALMOST no exploiting ;)[/p][/*][*][p]Fine-Tuning: Internal tests are promising, but balancing continues. We want mana costs to feel fair — never restricting experimentation or hindering fun moments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/7fdfff5cd8d0b0fc535ef4fdd4fec8c570d49b90.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Karamarin[/h3][p]Let’s explore more of the game’s world![/p][list][*][p]Is Karamarin the Whole World? To its inhabitants — yes! With just one massive landmass, "world," "planet," and "continent" are synonymous here.[/p][/*][*][p]Cataclysm & Consensus: The mysterious Great Patch emerged, shaking the world! Scientists from every corner of the world convened a grand conclave, declared the existence of other realms (dubbed Faramarin), and devised an "effective" plan to handle the aftermath: largely ignoring it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/e3a378846ff7de9477bb5f83e7c765d48257f7b7.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]Our top priority is refining the enemy traits system. We want every encounter to feel unique and reward creative tactics. Full details in the next update![/p][p][/p][p]Your Feedback Matters!
Share your ideas and questions in the comments or on our social media — your input shapes the game’s evolution.
[i]Thank you for journeying through the Patches of Karamarin with us![/i][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
Greetings, adventurers! We’re thrilled to share our latest progress in the game’s development. This update covers a visual overhaul, magical experiments, and introductions to key characters. Let’s dive in!

[b][h3]Visual Rebranding: Darker, Deeper, More Atmospheric[/h3][/b]
We’ve updated the visual style to better align with the game’s core spirit.
When you see our new cover art, you’ll no longer mistake our world for a cozy cross-stitch simulator! If you’ve grown fond of the majestic Sky Beast from the previous artwork — don’t worry, it remains Karamarin’s iconic symbol of magic, and you’ll encounter it many times!
In-game, the atmosphere has grown darker, and we’ve implemented the technical groundwork for dynamic time-of-day changes. These technical improvements will also help us craft future dungeons and mysterious new Patches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/44842ce41e5ef064403f79410dc3b25bf9215be7.png[/img]
[b][h3]Magic Evolves: Spellcrafting System Changes[/h3][/b]
We’ve reworked the spell creation system’s code for greater flexibility. The spell tree now tracks all magic shards used within it, enabling future features like:
[list]
[*] Set bonuses for shard combinations,
[*] Modifiers that preserve spell fragments,
[*] Visual and usability improvements to the crafting interface.
[/list]
This time, instead of adding new components, we removed compatibility restrictions! Now, [b]any[/b] component from a matching family can be placed into a child socket (e.g., two [i]Split Shots[/i] in a row). Limitations still exist but are tied to shards, meaning heroes who brave the most dangerous Patches can discover compatible shards to forge truly devastating spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/172fc5392061d68228cb770e71727d60c9e5f377.png[/img]
[b][h3]Karamarin’s First Archmages: Who Are They?[/h3][/b]
Meet the founders of the Arcane Academy (left to right): Varnava, Amalia, and Torvald.

⚒️ [b]Varnava[/b]
    [i]Role:[/i] First Arcane Smith, founder of the School of Magical Smithing.
    [i]Story:[/i] Survived his village’s destruction by the *Great Patch*. Learned to infuse magic shards into objects, which helped him survive the wilds and reach civilization.

🌀 [b]Amalia[/b]
    [i]Role:[/i] First Magic Seeker, founder of the Seekers’ School.
    [i]Story:[/i] A reckless genius who channeled shard energy into her own body. Arrived in the capital already mastering enchantments — her past remains a mystery.

⚡ [b]Torvald[/b]
    [i]Role:[/i] First Battlemage, founder of the School of Offensive Magic.
    [i]Story:[/i] Discovered the Misty Patch and theorized the "Slow Cataclysm." Believes magic is humanity’s ultimate tool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/73dd19e265e4dc223939b308f943d63b212febe2.png[/img]

[b][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][/b]
We’re currently developing the Advanced Resistance System and the Expedition Hub. Stay tuned for details!


Your Feedback Matters!
Share your ideas and questions in the comments or on our social media — your input shapes the game’s evolution.
[i]Thank you for journeying through the Patches of Karamarin with us![/i]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Greetings! We are starting to publish regular reports on the work done and changes made to the game, and this is the first such report.

First of all, we want to thank everyone who is interested in Patchworld. You inspire and motivate us to work harder and better.

We were pleasantly surprised by the interest from foreign players, so we decided to expand the list of game localizations. We will introduce this list in one of the upcoming development reports.

Recently, we have finished revising the hero's dynamics and implemented our own animation management system. It took a lot of time, but we achieved the desired responsiveness of the character and significantly improved the overall impression of fighting monsters.

In addition, we have introduced the mechanics of shards rarity and set spells. Players can find set shards and create a stronger spell with them, which will have additional attributes. Alternatively, players may find very rare unique shards that include special combinations and components. So far, we have implemented only a simplified version of these mechanics and will complete them in the near future.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/f0ee34ecd383f48bf65cf748316ec10d4d74c3d0.jpg[/img]

And, of course, we've added a few new spell components:
[list]
[*] Coordinate - allows you to deliver the effects of your spell to a specific point, bypassing all obstacles and terrain features. However, this component has a delay before activation and limitations on the range of application.
[*] Pulsation - triggers several times at regular intervals and can additionally generate child projectiles or explosions.
[*] Target capture - a projectile modifier. A projectile with this modifier can gradually change its direction of movement and will constantly try to hit the captured target, even if the target is moving.
[*] Blink - takes the caster to the triggered point. Yes, there are mobility spells in the game! However, such a component should be used with caution: no one wants to be moved to random points 10 times per second.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45148855/55b6ccdbee89d8242f091380751db10e35f3e60c.jpg[/img]

Our small team continues to actively develop the game, and we will publish more news when important features are implemented.
Feel free to ask questions and leave your feedback and suggestions here or on our social media - it helps us to adjust the direction of the game's development and make it better.
